services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Looking for a thrilling ride? Try our jet skis for the ultimate experience. You will become a qualified driver after our safety training and test. You’ll ride in our bay and will be supervised by our guides at all times. Want to experience the water with your family and friends? Take our Pontoon Boat down the river and go tubing, or skim the water while fishing. Our 90-HP Tritoon will make the best group activity Set your tube into the bay and venture south down the Hudson River on a relaxing, beginner-friendly ride between 1.5 and 2.5 hours, depending on the current.
